newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER-UNBEATEN FEYENOORD PIP PSV TO LEAD DUTCH LEAGUE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-UNBEATEN FEYENOORD PIP PSV TO LEAD DUTCH LEAGUE.

text.p: Feyenoord Rotterdam defeated Willem II Tilburg 4-1 on Saturday to take the lead in the Dutch first division from PSV Eindhoven.
PSV, unbeaten this season, host NAC Breda on Sunday.
Feyenoord grabbed an early lead when Argentine Pablo Sanchez scored in the seventh minute but had difficulty imposing their authority on the match.

Three minutes after the break Henry van der Vegt equalised before Dutch international Gaston Taument, Henk Vos and Swedish international Henke Larsson each scored in the space of 15 minutes for Feyenoord.
